clue.text: Without doubt a driving test consumes energy

indicators.note: consumes means the driving test swallows the next piece, so it goes inside

parts.note: a rally is a motoring event testing driving skill
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A motorist's test eats up a lot of fuel, without question.
explanation.definitionFit: Really used as a sentence adverb is a synonym of certainly, beyond question.

clue.text: Concerned with drink and crack

parts.note: re means regarding or concerning
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Someone involved with drink and drugs, crack being the drug.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is a loud bang, like the crack of a gunshot.

clue.text: Like very jumbled sheets? Help Vera collate afresh

indicators.note: afresh tells us to collate the letters again in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone asks Vera to help put a muddled stack of pages back in order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collate' looks like the instruction, but it is part of the fodder; 'afresh' alone tells you to rearrange HELP VERA COLLATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Papers scattered in disarray are strewn everywhere, a jumbled mess.

clue.text: Take off authority

definitions.meaning: permission, as in being given ... to do something

explanation.definitionFit: To go means to depart, and permission granted is what a soldier gets when off duty.

clue.text: Horses eating one kind of rock plant

indicators.note: eating means the horses take the next piece inside them

parts.note: Arabs are a breed of horse
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Horses munching a kind of plant that grows on rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabis is a genus of low-growing alpine flowers often planted in rockeries.

clue.text: His relations (funnily enough) are not always short

definitions.text: His relations (funnily enough) are not always short

parts.words: His relations (funnily enough) are not always short
parts.note: relations reads as family members but means the tales a person relates, funny ones that can go on at length

explanation.surface: A man whose relatives, oddly, are not all small.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relations' suggests family; here it means things related, i.e. stories, told amusingly and at length.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled storyteller recounts anecdotes, often amusing and long-winded.

clue.text: Desertion in the face of an engagement

definitions.text: Desertion in the face of an engagement

parts.words: Desertion in the face of an engagement
parts.note: reads as a soldier fleeing battle, but the engagement is a promise to marry that is broken off

explanation.surface: A soldier runs away when the battle starts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desertion' and 'engagement' paint a military picture; the engagement is a betrothal, and jilting a fiancé was once a cause for legal action.
explanation.definitionFit: Failing to honour a pledge to wed was a legal wrong for which damages could be claimed.

clue.text: Remarks about Queen and also a British detective writer

indicators.note: about means the remarks surround the next piece

parts.note: says as a noun plural, things said, remarks
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Comments about the Queen and a British crime novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Dorothy L. Sayers created the amateur sleuth Lord Peter Wimsey.

clue.text: Almost jaded, the Spanish horse

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: sorry in the sense of worn out and in a poor state, as a sorry nag
el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A Spanish horse that is nearly worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: A sorrel is a horse of reddish-brown colouring.

clue.text: Cocaine in hypes for blowing one's mind

indicators.note: in places the drug's letter within the rearranged word
blowing suggests the letters of hypes being blown about and scattered

parts.note: C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: Cocaine taken amid the hype to blow one's mind.
explanation.definitionFit: The psyche is the human soul or mental self.

clue.text: Public figure with high profile (also involved with City?)

indicators.note: involved means tangled together, so the letters of all three words are mixed up
high as in intoxicated, so the letters of profile are reeling

explanation.surface: A celebrity with a high profile who also has dealings in the City of London.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district. 'high' scrambles PROFILE and 'involved with' mixes it with ALSO and CITY, so the whole is an anagram of PROFILE ALSO CITY.
explanation.definitionFit: A pillar of society is a respected, prominent citizen in public life.

clue.text: Show with vocal parade

indicators.note: vocal says the word for parade is spoken rather than written

parts.note: a review is a formal military inspection or parade

explanation.surface: A show featuring a singing procession.
explanation.definitionFit: A revue is a theatrical entertainment of sketches, songs and dances.

clue.text: Pits may well provide one with fuel

definitions.text: Pits may well provide one with fuel

parts.words: Pits may well provide one with fuel
parts.note: pits sound like coal mines supplying fuel, but they are the motor-racing pit lane refuelling a car

explanation.surface: Coal mines are likely to supply fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pits' and 'fuel' suggest coal mining; in motor sport the pits are where cars refuel during a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A Formula One car takes on petrol at pit stops during a race.

clue.text: Gold traffic exposed in trial

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
to traffic is to deal or trade

explanation.surface: Gold smuggling brought to light in court.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful experience, a test of endurance.

clue.text: Carried out manoeuvres and removed captured Queen

indicators.note: captured means the removed word holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: excised means cut out or removed
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Troops on manoeuvres took the Queen prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops exercised when they performed drills or military exercises.

clue.text: New tail of Concorde's inverted wing flap

indicators.note: inverted means the whole run of letters is turned back to front

parts.note: novel means new

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A new tail fitted to Concorde's upside-down wing part.
explanation.definitionFit: An elevon is an aircraft control surface combining elevator and aileron, used on delta wings.

clue.text: Started taking in counsel's ultimate defence

indicators.note: taking in means the startled word swallows the next letter

parts.note: shied, as a horse does when startled, means started

indicators.note: ultimate means the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A barrister's final defence got under way.
explanation.definitionFit: A shield is protection, a means of guarding against attack.

clue.text: Slavers expressing Democratic principles vocally

indicators.note: vocally means the pieces are spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for Democratic, and rules are principles, giving D plus RULES

explanation.surface: Slave traders voicing democratic ideals, a hypocritical picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slavers' reads as slave traders; it is the verb, dribbles saliva. D plus RULES said quickly gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To slaver is to dribble saliva from the mouth.

clue.text: Insect moves lightly round front of hive

indicators.note: round means the moving word goes around the next letter

parts.note: to trip is to step nimbly

indicators.note: front of means the first letter of hive

explanation.surface: A bug flits around the entrance of a beehive.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrips are tiny winged bugs that damage plants.

clue.text: Infusion of leaves from tansies, mostly, well soaked

indicators.note: well soaked as in drunk, so the letters stagger into a new order
mostly means all but the final letter of tansies are used

explanation.surface: A herbal brew made from tansy leaves steeped well in water.
explanation.definitionFit: A tisane is a herbal tea made by steeping leaves.

clue.text: Animal confined to pen is driven to distraction

indicators.note: confined to means the animal sits inside the pen

parts.note: a sty is a pigpen
cat is an animal

explanation.surface: A creature cooped up in a pen goes mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Scatty describes someone scatterbrained and absent-minded.

clue.text: Instrument short? Turned up in group

indicators.note: in places the turned word within the group

parts.note: a set is a group

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a nip is a short measure of spirits

explanation.surface: A small musical instrument, flipped over, among a band.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinet is a small harpsichord.

clue.text: Top account meets debts, able to accommodate many

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid
IOUs are written promises of debt

explanation.surface: A capped bank account covers outstanding bills.
explanation.definitionFit: Capacious means roomy, spacious enough to hold a lot.

clue.text: Touch of slip applied to rounded pot vessel

indicators.note: a touch of a word is just its first letter
rounded means turned round, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: a pool, as in a kitty, is a pot of money

explanation.surface: A potter applies slip to a rounded clay pot.
explanation.walkthrough: Slip is liquid clay a potter uses, so 'vessel' seems to mean the pot; it is a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloop is a single-masted sailing boat.

clue.text: Second piece in issue

parts.note: a pawn is a chess piece

explanation.surface: A second item in a publication's issue.
explanation.definitionFit: Spawn means offspring or progeny.

clue.text: Artisan, not worried about factory's change of location

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters surround the next piece
worried suggests the letters being agitated and shaken into a new order

parts.note: a plant is a factory

explanation.surface: A craftsman unbothered by the factory relocating.
explanation.definitionFit: Transplantation is moving something from one place to another.

clue.text: Gives up or proceeds?

definitions.meaning: returns or profits from an investment, as a noun

explanation.definitionFit: To surrender is to cede, and the income an investment produces is its return.

clue.text: Trendy school catering for cricket?

parts.note: in means fashionable
a sect is a school of thought

explanation.surface: A fashionable school providing for the game of cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cricket' suggests the bat-and-ball game; it is the chirping creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket is a chirping, jumping bug.
